name: @innexar/cloud
description: Monorepo da plataforma Innexar (apps independentes, sem workspaces compartilhados)

scripts.build: npm run build --prefix apps/workspace && npm run build --prefix apps/portal && npm run build --prefix apps/website-us && npm run build --prefix apps/website-br
scripts.test: npm test --prefix apps/portal && npm test --prefix apps/website-us
